en: A historical, sepia-toned postcard showing a large group of men in military uniforms standing and observing an outdoor training or drill in a courtyard with wooden buildings in the background. One man is actively thrusting a bayonet or pole into a straw-filled target as an officer watches. Some uniforms strongly resemble those from the late Russian Empire or early 20th-century Finland. Trees and two ladders can be seen against the buildings. The main text on the front is printed in red Cyrillic letters, spelling 'Kuopio.' The publisher 'Glouxberg & Co., Viborg, Wiburi.' is printed along the side.
